d: In this video, Firstpost fact-checks US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr's claims that Arabs do not contribute to science, literature or win prestigious international awards. Speaking at a campaign event in Michigan, Kennedy made sweeping remarks about Arab intellectual achievements. But do the facts support his claims? From Nobel Prize winners Ahmed Zewail and Naguib Mahfouz to 2025 Chemistry Nobel laureate Omar Yaghi, the historical record tells a different story. We examine the achievements that challenge Kennedy's controversial remarks. Cary Johnston brings you the details on…
